tests.claim: A freshly signed 5-record approval ledger passes verifyApprovalLedger
tests.detail: All 5 HMAC signatures and newest-to-oldest previousHash links verified.

tests.claim: Changing an approval field without recomputing the HMAC is detected
tests.detail: Record story-00002 (index 2) fails signature verification. The previousHash pointer on that record still matches the next signature; the broken link is the HMAC seal, not the chain pointer.

checks.reason: HMAC does not match the record payload and previousHash

tests.claim: Deleting a middle approval is detected
tests.detail: Removed story-00002. The newer neighbor's previousHash still names the deleted signature, so that chain link fails.

checks.reason: previousHash does not match the next record's signature

tests.claim: Deleting the oldest approval is detected
tests.detail: The new tail record's previousHash is the deleted signature, not null, so the tail link fails.

checks.reason: previousHash does not match the next record's signature

tests.claim: Swapping two adjacent approvals is detected
tests.detail: Adjacent swap breaks previousHash links around the swapped pair.

checks.reason: previousHash does not match the next record's signature
previousHash does not match the next record's signature
previousHash does not match the next record's signature

tests.claim: An inserted approval with an invented signature is detected
tests.detail: The inserted record's HMAC does not verify, and neighboring previousHash links no longer match.

checks.reason: previousHash does not match the next record's signature
HMAC does not match this record, and previousHash does not match the next signature

tests.claim: Dropping the two oldest approvals (truncated tail) is detected
tests.detail: The surviving tail still points at a removed signature instead of null.

checks.reason: previousHash does not match the next record's signature

tests.claim: Dropping the newest approval is detected
tests.detail: Not detected. verifyApprovalLedger returned passed=true. The remaining records are still a consistent newest-to-oldest chain. Nothing stores the chain head, the length, or an external anchor, so deleting the newest record is invisible to this verifier.

tests.claim: Deleting every approval is detected
tests.detail: Not detected. verifyApprovalLedger([]) returns passed=true because every check on an empty list is vacuously true. Wiping the approval array looks valid.

tests.claim: A brand-new chain signed with the key this process already trusts is rejected
tests.detail: Not rejected. verifyApprovalLedger returned passed=true for a chain this harness built with signApprovalPayload. In this environment signatureMode is local-dev-hmac-sha256. The development key ships in source and is the default signer, so anyone with the repo can produce a ledger this verifier accepts. This is a property of the default demo key, not a bypass of a private production secret.

tests.claim: A production-like environment without a signing secret refuses to sign
tests.detail: evaluateSigningPosture reports ok=false and resolveSigningSecret throws. The shipped development key is not used to sign in that posture.

evidence.reason: SENTINELOPS_SIGNING_SECRET is required in a production-like environment so audit records are not signed with the public development key.

tests.claim: verifyApprovalLedger checks a 10,000-record chain, including one edited record
tests.detail: Built 10,000 HMAC-signed approvals in 64.7 ms and verified them in 47.1 ms. Editing record index 5000 was detected.

tests.claim: Rebuilding an evidence manifest or full export for the same data keeps the same top-level hash
tests.detail: Not stable. manifestSha256 changed=true (generatedAt 2026-11-08T11:15:31.316Z vs 2026-11-08T11:15:31.322Z). exportSha256 changed=true. The timestamp is inside the hashed body, so the handoff hash is not a content address of the evidence. Section hashes are a separate check.

tests.claim: The auditEvents section hash changes when an audit event string changes
tests.detail: The auditEvents section hash is stable across identical rebuilds and changes when the event text changes. This is a content hash of the array, not a stored anchor and not a per-event chain.

tests.claim: Individual audit events are hash-chained the way approvals are
tests.detail: Not implemented. Audit events in the evidence state are { id, at, runId, event }. They have no previousHash and no signature. verifyApprovalLedger covers approvals only. A whole-array section hash is computed when a manifest is built.

tests.claim: A stored manifest hash is rechecked later and rejects a divergent manifest
tests.detail: Not implemented. server/audit-integrity.mjs exports: buildEvidenceBundle, buildEvidenceManifest, buildFullAuditExport, signApprovalPayload, verifyApprovalLedger, verifyApprovalSignature. Manifests and exports are generated with a hash. Nothing in this module stores that hash and verifies a later copy against it.

tests.claim: An approval that fails the policy check is not persisted as an approval
tests.detail: Not blocked. Missing "Rollback playbook" makes policy status "fail". updateState still saved the approval, and the run's approvalState is "Approved for controlled pilot". Failing checks: evidence-rollback-playbook, pac-evid-003. The same function the POST /api/runs/:id/approval handler calls (applyGateDecision) returns the signed approval anyway.

tests.claim: The deterministic reviewer does not recommend allow-scoped-write-tools when required evidence is missing
tests.detail: runDeploymentReview returned recommendation "block" and toolUseDecision "approval-required". This is a recommendation string. No tool executor consults it before performing a write.

tests.claim: A runtime tool executor refuses a write when the reviewer says policy-blocked or approval-required
tests.detail: Not implemented. toolUseDecision is referenced in: agent/sentinelops-agent.mjs, evals/run-local.mjs, scripts/smoke-agent.mjs, scripts/smoke-alert-routing.mjs, scripts/smoke-audit-integrity.mjs, scripts/smoke-observability.mjs, src/lib/types.ts. Nothing under server/ executes an external tool write and blocks on that field. The deterministic reviewer only returns the string.

tests.claim: If policy evaluation throws, the approval is not persisted
tests.detail: Policy evaluation threw TypeError: decision.reviewer.trim is not a function. The decision had a numeric reviewer, so evaluateApprovalPolicy crashed on reviewer.trim() after the policy file had loaded. updateState did not save. The state file hash was unchanged. This is an exception abort, not a dedicated policy-error result.

tests.claim: If the approval policy file is missing, the approval is not persisted
tests.detail: With server/policies/agent-action-policy.json moved aside, policy load threw ENOENT. The state file was not rewritten. The file was restored afterward.

tests.claim: A policy check that exceeds a deadline is aborted and the write is refused
tests.detail: Not implemented. server/policy-engine.mjs and server/policy-as-code.mjs do not take a timeout, AbortSignal, or deadline. A hung check is not interrupted by product code. No timeout was faked.

tests.claim: The local state store rejects an in-place edit of an approval (append-only enforcement)
tests.detail: Not implemented. createLocalJsonStore.saveState rewrote the whole JSON document when an approval was inserted, and loadState returned it. The README calls the ledger append-only. The local adapter does not refuse historical edits. Detection, when it works, happens later in verifyApprovalLedger.

tests.claim: A requirement marked Fail is not rendered as a fully implemented NIST control, and it appears on the POA&M
tests.detail: Flipped GA-1 to Fail in a copy of the conformance report. 1 mapped control(s) have implemented=false, and the POA&M lists the requirement. The generator was not told to hide it.

tests.claim: Compliance evidence re-runs the conformance checks before marking a control Implemented
tests.detail: Not implemented. buildControlImplementations was given a report copy with every requirement forced to Pass. All 34 mapped controls came back implemented=true. No conformance script was executed. The generator trusts the status strings it is given.

tests.claim: The POA&M keeps the stated external authorization gaps, including independent assessment
tests.detail: buildPoam includes an external 3PAO gap from DEFAULT_AUTHORIZATION_GAPS. The continuous-monitoring plan lists 48 requirements, matching the conformance map. Live report open findings: 0.

tests.claim: POST /api/runs and POST /api/runs/:id/approval produce a ledger GET /api/audit/integrity accepts
tests.detail: Three local-dev approvals were stored by the real server and the integrity endpoint reported the ledger passed.

tests.claim: GET /api/audit/integrity reports failure after an approval field is edited on disk
tests.detail: The API reread the state file and verifyApprovalLedger returned passed=false. validSignatures=2 of 3.

tests.claim: A mutating request containing an SSN-shaped string is rejected before it is stored
tests.detail: POST /api/runs returned 422 and the run count stayed 3. Category reported: ssn. The raw string was not copied into this result. This block is the pilot data-boundary scanner, not the AI policy gate.
